implication: Filing of Reg 31(4) disclosure marks entry into the 90-day mandatory offer window; acquirer must now comply with open offer requirements, pricing benchmarks, and disclosure milestones-critical for deal closure and shareholder communication strategy.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
framework.note: Regulation 31(4): disclosure requirement upon acquisition triggering takeover provisions; sets open offer trigger thresholds (25% for acquirer acquisition intent, 26% for actual control)
Open offer timing, quantum (100% of remaining shares), and target dissemination; mandatory within 30 days of acquisition triggering threshold
Valuation norms: highest price paid in prior 52 weeks or volumetric-weighted average price for pricing open offer (amended Feb 2023)
Conditions precedent and reverse flips: acquirer may impose max 3 conditions; no single condition may relate to regulatory approval alone
Takeover disclosure and shareholder approval milestones; preferential allotment rules if acquirer is related party or promoter
Material event and related-party transaction disclosure requirements; acquirer insider trading restrictions during offer window
Jurisdictional threshold test: combination notifiable to CCI if turnover or assets cross ₹2,000 cr (or combined ₹6,000 cr); standalone assessment if applicable
Trading restrictions and disclosures by acquirer and connected persons during offer window; continuous disclosure of shareholding

parties: Jusmiral Holdings Limited (acquirer); Cohance Lifesciences Limited (target)
headline: Jusmiral Holdings submits substantial acquisition disclosure for Cohance Lifesciences under SEBI takeover code
sum: Jusmiral Holdings Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Cohance Lifesciences Limited, triggering SEBI Takeover Regulations. The disclosure indicates a material stake acquisition in the pharma company and initiates formal regulatory review under the takeover code.
detail: Jusmiral Holdings Limited has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition event in Cohance Lifesciences. This disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer crosses 25% threshold or intends material control acquisition. The filing initiates regulatory gating under the takeover code, requiring open offer mechanics, independent valuations, and adherence to pricing norms tied to the highest price paid in prior 52 weeks or volumetric average.
